## The Non-Profit Hiring Challenge

Non-profits operate on tight budgets. Traditional recruiting fees consume funds that should go toward programs and impact.

Grant-funded positions have specific timelines. You need talent when funding arrives, not 3 months later.

Finding professionals who combine capability with genuine passion for your mission requires specialized sourcing.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Mission-aligned professionals with genuine non-profit sector passion
- Grant writers and development officers with proven fundraising track records
- Program managers experienced in grant compliance and outcome reporting
- Flexible capacity that matches your funding cycles and grant periods
- No placement fees—every dollar goes further toward your mission
